mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM customer_tag t INNER JOIN customer_tag_relation r ON t.id = r.tag_id WHERE r.customer_id = #{customerId} AND t.organization_id = r.organization_id ORDER BY t.update_time DESC
SELECT * FROM customer_tag WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} ORDER BY usage_count DESC, update_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_tag SET usage_count = usage_count + 1, update_time = UNIX_TIMESTAMP() * 1000 WHERE id = #{tagId}
